# 07.16.02 XAL specification: Axis shorthand

### Axis shorthand

| Class | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `px-{n}` | padding left + right = n × 8px |
| `py-{n}` | padding top + bottom = n × 8px |
| `mx-{n}` | margin left + right = n × 8px |
| `my-{n}` | margin top + bottom = n × 8px |
